provenance.note: Owner-authorized reviewed chapter 6 production authoring/adaptation, 5 October 2026. All 35 assigned observed source rows, physical response counts, exercise/activity identities and occurrence support timing are retained. Japanese text, readings, translations, response banks and reviewed equivalence are authored replacements based on documented targets, not observed quotations. Tourist-information dialogue and complete rail announcement are coherent original scenes; rail announcement voices are app casting using compatible internal guest/staff IDs with configurable announcement labels. No English scene translation was observed; every turn therefore has explicit null English. Seven documented replay links bind exact complete scenes, including unsupported choice and ordering. Checkpoint S07 retains the observed token_gap renderer despite the handoff typed paraphrase. Limited feedback remains target-only where a full transcript was not observed. Text polish 1.1.0 (8 October 2026, owner-approved text-only pass over 1.0.0): learner-facing wording, Australian English spelling, reading-line spacing and instruction-template wording were revised. Answer keys, accepted forms, tokens, option sets/IDs/order, screen IDs, partitions, counts, retry policies, source contracts, evidence and support timing/visibility are unchanged from 1.0.0; b2-polish/pack-text-validation.mjs verifies this.

policies.assessment: One equal-weight outcome per graded base screen. Core completion and first-attempt accuracy remain distinct; no checkpoint threshold is inferred.
policies.incorrectResponses: Existing feedback/Check/token and pair mechanics. No lesson or checkpoint retry is documented or configured.
policies.audio: Current Japanese TTS with all-turn full-scene replay. No original audio or acoustic fidelity is claimed. Hidden full scripts stay absent from pre-answer support; limited feedback remains limited.
policies.visuals: Original media is deferred; current shared replaceable visual slots are used. No recording, speaking or pronunciation action.

unresolvedSourceFacts: Literal source wording, exhaustive accepted forms, speaker identities and acoustic/media alignment remain unobserved; the replacement scenes and answer banks are reviewed app authoring.
Source scoring, exactly-80-percent threshold boundaries and causal unlock/retry rules remain unknown. Research results never seed owner progress.

screens.prompt: Read and listen to advice at the tourist information desk.

dialogue.context: 観光案内所で、観光客が駅から観光地への行き方を尋ねています。

turns.speaker: guest
turns.japanese: すみません。この観光地は駅から遠いですか。
turns.reading: すみません。この かんこうちは えきから とおいですか。

turns.speaker: staff
turns.japanese: はい、遠いので、歩いて行きにくいです。電車で行った方がいいですよ。
turns.reading: はい、とおいので、あるいて いきにくいです。でんしゃで いったほうが いいですよ。

turns.speaker: guest
turns.japanese: 電車の情報はどこにありますか。
turns.reading: でんしゃの じょうほうは どこに ありますか。

turns.speaker: staff
turns.japanese: こちらの案内をご覧ください。駅から乗り換えなしで行けるので、行きやすいですよ。
turns.reading: こちらの あんないを ごらんください。えきから のりかえなしで いけるので、いきやすいですよ。

turns.speaker: guest
turns.japanese: ありがとうございます。電車で行ってみます。
turns.reading: ありがとうございます。でんしゃで いってみます。

screens.prompt: Which request in the information-desk scene respectfully asks the tourist to look?

options.text: こちらの案内を食べてください。
こちらの案内をご覧ください。

after.text: こちらの案内をご覧ください。

お + verb masu stem + ください forms a respectful request: 乗り換えます → お乗り換えください. Ordinary 乗り換えてください is grammatical, but the requested respectful stem pattern uses 乗り換え. ご覧ください is the established respectful look request.
